headline: Six Fronts Surge as Bases Change Hands
war_summary: Since the last edition at 09:19 the war’s hottest sectors have intensified. Weathered Expanse remains the most volatile, recording 55 ownership changes in the past 24 hours and four in the last two, with Warden casualties climbing to 214 per hour. Stlican Shelf follows closely with 36 daily flips and five fresh changes, both sides seeing accelerating loss rates. Godcrofts has erupted, logging 28 daily transitions and six new events in the past two hours, while casualties and enlistments surge for both factions. Stonecradle added 27 daily flips and three recent changes, its casualty curves steepening. Linn Mercy continues to churn with 27 daily flips and a sharp rise in enlistments, though no new two‑hour events appear. Fisherman’s Row shows 14 daily flips and a fresh capture, casualties steady but enlistments rising. Viper Pit, Marban Hollow and Callahan’s Passage also register heightened activity, but the six fronts above dominate the current tactical picture and are most likely to produce further base‑ownership shifts in the next day.
